parameters.note: Miller Lake is a small mountain lake in the McKinney Creek–Rubicon Trail area west of McKinney Bay, in the Sierra Nevada crest zone of Placer County, immediately adjacent to (but outside) the Desolation Wilderness. It is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) governs — open all year, 5 trout/10. As a lake (not a flowing tributary reach), it is not reached by the Lake Tahoe tributary catch-and-release closure in §7.50(b)(152), which applies to Tahoe tributaries 'upstream to the first lake.' No fish species or stocking are asserted: Miller Lake is absent from CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document and no current authoritative source names a species; trout planting in this area largely ceased after 2008, though third-party trail accounts still describe fishing here.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
